pages.text: A fully charged hit on a pixie with this $(l:material_pixie_silver)Pixie Silver$() trait has a 2.5% chance per level to yield treasure. If it triggers, it randomly selects one of six loot tables and rolls it 2–4 times: fishing treasure, ancient city, buried treasure, Nether fortress, bastion treasure room, or End city.

A hit on any other creature has a 5% chance per level to steal its held item and inflict Levitation III for 5 seconds. Mining a block highlights entities and block entities within 5 blocks per trait level for 3 seconds.
